note: Per-class calling, chosen by family-grouped 5-fold cross-validation over the 130 CPT-curated genomes (genomes whose curated genes are >= 30% identical never split across folds). HOLIN and ENDOLYSIN: context rule, z = logit(P) + beta * strongest other-class P within W genes; confident when z >= call_z (or, with --domains, a catalytic/family lysis domain). SPANIN: learned second-stage caller (models/spanin_caller.pkl); confident when its score >= 0.02. Top pick correct, known | novel family: holin 0.81 | 0.62; endolysin 0.92 | 0.79; spanin 0.91 | 0.80. Confident calls, precision / recall, known | novel: holin 0.93/0.64 | 0.90/0.33; endolysin 0.95/0.87 | 0.85/0.64; spanin 0.98/0.69 | 0.98/0.51. Precision is against CPT curation.
